shortDescription: Immutable X (IMX) is scheduled to unlock about 9.62 million tokens at 8:00 AM on October 3, according to Web3 asset data platform RootData's token unlock data. According to ChainCatcher, the unlocked tokens are valued at about $1.54 million.
